"content": "### `cloud eval run`\n\nStart an eval run of an existing suite, or upload a versioned suite file and run it. Provide *
*either** `--suite` **or** `--file`, not both.\n\nBy default the command prints a launch receipt and returns immediately. `--wait`
polls every launched run to a terminal state.\n\n**Exit codes (`--wait` only).** Without `--wait` this command's exit code is unc
hanged: `0` on any launch, `1` on a partial or wholly failed fan-out. `--wait` owns a separate six-code contract — a caller who as

ked this process to sit and watch a ru

| Code | Meaning |
| - | - |
| `0` | Every waited run passed, unanimously, and (when a
report was requested) every report was assembled |\n| `1` | A run **completed** with a **failed** verdict. The only condition tha
t produces this code |\n| `2` | Usage error — bad flags, `--reporter`/`--out` without `--wait`, or an invalid suite file (after au
th, before any server/model work) |\n| `3` | Auth failed — no credential, or the platform rejected it, at launch or mid-wait (a to
ken that expired during a long poll). Zero credits spent if it happened before launch |\n| `4` | Connection/setup failed before ev
aluation — a launch failure this CLI itself observed (network, timeout, rate limit, a partial or failed fan-out, an unrecognized l
aunch error), or a local `--out` write failure — unless a more severe outco\n| `5` | No valid verdict — `inconclusive`, a null/unr
ecognized result, a run whose own status is failed/cancelled/timed-out, a wait that hit its deadline, a mid-wait failure that was
not auth-shaped, or a report that could not be assembled |\n\nNo infrastructure condition ever maps to `1` — see the same rule und
er `eval gate` below. A multi-target launch merges these worst-of across every waited run, in the order `1 > 3 > 4 > 5 > 0`: a rea
l verdict failure is never masked by a sibling's i\n\nThis six-code contract is new and deliberately **different** from `eval gate
`'s four codes below — see that command's own doc for why the two are not unified. An invalid suite file exits **2** either way —

`eval validate` still exits 1 for the sa

| Flag | Required | Description |
| - | - | - |
| `--suite <id-or-name>` | Yes, unle
ss `--file` | Eval suite name or ID |\n| `--file <path>` | Yes, unless `--suite` | Versioned suite file to upload and run (`.yaml`
or `.json`, or `-` for stdin) |\n| `--project <id-or-name>` | No | Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently updated proj
ect) |\n| `--server <id-or-name...>` | No | Override the suite's saved server selection (HTTP servers only) |\n| `--environment <i
d-or-name...>` | No | Attached project environment(s) to run. Several values start one **paid run each**. |\n| `--client <id-or-na
me...>` | No | Attached client(s) to run, so the run is stamped with that client's config. Several values start one **paid run eac
h**. |\n| `--host <id-or-name...>` | No | **Deprecated** alias for `--client`. Passing both is an error. Not the host-compat catal
og id `mcpjam compat --host` / `mcpjam tools --host` take — see [Two different `--host` flags](#two-different---host-flags). |\n|
`--all-targets` | No | Run **every** attached environment (or, if none, every attached host) — one **paid run per target** |\n| `-
-iterations <n>` | No | Run each case this many times (1-10), for this run only |\n| `--repetitions <n>` | No | **Legacy** spellin
g of `--iterations`. Passing both is an error. |\n| `--case <id-or-title...>` | No | Run only these cases instead of the whole sui
te |\n| `--exclude-skills` | No | Run the \"without skills\" A/B arm: nothing is pinned, and the run is labelled as excluded |\n|
`--refresh-snapshot` | No | **Persists a new host-config snapshot on the suite** (see below). Single-target runs only. |\n| `--not
es <text>` | No | Free-text note stored on the run |\n| `--min-pass-rate <n>` | No | Pass threshold for this run (0-100), overridi
ng the suite's own |\n| `--match-options <json>` | No | Tool-call match options for this run, e.g. `'{\"toolCallOrder\":\"exact\"}
'` |\n| `--idempotency-key <key>` | No | Retry key for a lost launch response. For `--file`, a fresh key is minted and printed on
every invocation when this flag is omitted; supply the printed key to replay the same run instead of starting a new one |\n| `--wa
it` | No | Wait for every launched run to reach a terminal status |\n| `--wait-timeout <ms>` | No | Maximum wait time (default 210
0000); requires `--wait` |\n| `--reporter <json-summary\\|junit-xml\\|html>` | No | Write the completed structured report to stdou
t; requires `--wait`. `html` is a self-contained decision summary + failures page — traces/parity/history are not included. |\n| `
--out <path>` | No | Atomically write the completed report to a file; defaults to `json-summary`, or uses `--reporter` when presen
t; requires `--wait` |\n| `--compose-client <id-or-name>` | No | Compose a stack to run instead of naming a saved environment (see
below). **Ephemeral by default** — pass `--save-targets` to attach it to the suite. |\n| `--compose-host <id-or-name>` | No | **D
eprecated** alias for `--compose-client` |\n| `--compose-computer <id-or-name>` | No | Sandbox image to pin on the composed stack
|\n| `--compose-model <id...>` | No | Model(s) to run on the composed stack. Replaces the client's pinned model unless `--with-cli
ent-default` is set |\n| `--compose-model-selection <json...>` | No | Whole saved model selection(s) — source, connection, `settin
gs.reasoningEffort` — as JSON: one cell per selection, for its model, at its effort. Repeat to add several selections for one mode
l (e.g. a\n| `--with-client-default` | No | Also launch an inherit cell using each client's pinned model, alongside `--compose-mod
el` |\n| `--compose-server <id-or-name...>` | No | Server(s) to pin on the composed stack, snapshotted into a server group so a re
run keeps testing them. Mutually exclusive with `--compose-server-group` |\nUsing MCPJam Cloud as sk_…etic · project: flag (projec
t_fixture) · http://fixture:8765/api/v1\nEval idempotency key: 53b04a18-7529-41a7-bf0b-d7616c2eb05b\n{\"error\":{\"code\":\"INTERN
AL_ERROR\",\"message\":\"Synthetic fixture executes deterministic toolCall steps and simple assertions only; hosted prompt/model e
xecution is not implemented.\\nRetry this launch with --idempotency-key 53b04a18-7529-41a7-bf0b-d7616c2eb05b.\",\"details\":{\"ide
mpotencyKey\":\"53b04a18-7529-41a7-bf0b-d7616c2eb05b\"}}}", "is_error": false}]}, "parent_tool_use_id": null, "session_id": "abaf6
